name: CMOS differential commutating mixer
description: Four transmission gates alternately pass and reverse a differential input; a CMOS inverter generates the complementary LO. Ten MOS devices, two 40 kohm loads referenced to 1.65 V and two 100 fF capacitors are explicit. The saved experiment mixes a 1.1 MHz, 200 mV differential input with a 1 MHz square-wave LO. Coherent 100 kHz quadrature averages check the translated component, with DC and unconverted-RF rejection checks. The output also contains switching harmonics and needs filtering in an application. Educational Level-1 nominal behavior; no noise, linearity, RF parasitic or PVT qualification.
